data.one_liner: Simplifies the task of updating your Flutter app's launcher icon across platforms.
data.what_it_does: A command-line tool that updates application launcher icons for Android, iOS, web, Windows, and macOS based on a configuration file. It supports adaptive icons, dark and tinted mode icons for iOS 18+, and automated config generation.
use_when: You need to set up or update custom app launcher icons across multiple target platforms.
You want to generate platform-specific launcher assets (like Android adaptive icons or iOS icons) from a source image.
avoid_when: You only require a runtime image handling library inside your app UI.
You prefer manually configuring and dropping raw image files into every native platform project folder.
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, and macOS.
Supports advanced icon variants like Android adaptive/monochrome icons and iOS 18 dark/tinted icons.
Simple configuration via pubspec.yaml or a separate YAML file with command-line generation support.
weaknesses: It is a CLI tool rather than a runtime widget library, so it must be run explicitly via the terminal.
data.setup_notes: Add the package as a dev_dependency in pubspec.yaml, define your configuration block, and run 'dart run flutter_launcher_icons'.

alternatives.name: icons_launcher
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative command-line package for generating Flutter launcher icons.

data.minimal_example:
dev_dependencies:
  flutter_launcher_icons: "^0.14.4"

flutter_launcher_icons:
  android: "launcher_icon"
  ios: true
  image_path: "assets/icon/icon.png"
